# incident_announcement_rule (Data Source)

Create and manage announcement rules.

An announcement rule posts an announcement of each incident that matches its conditions
into the channels it lists, rendered with an announcement template.


Use this data source to look up an existing announcement rule, either by `id` or by `name`, without managing it as an `incident_announcement_rule` resource. Set exactly one of the two lookup attributes; setting both, or neither, is rejected at plan time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing announcement rule by name, such as one created in the dashboard.
data "incident_announcement_rule" "critical" {
  name = "Critical incidents"
}

# Or by ID, to reference a rule another module manages.
data "incident_announcement_rule" "payments" {
  id = "01G0J1EXE7AXZ2C93K61WBPYEH"
}

output "critical_slack_channel_ids" {
  value = data.incident_announcement_rule.critical.slack_channel_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this announcement rule
- `name` (String) Human readable name for the rule

### Read-Only

- `condition_groups` (Attributes List) The condition groups to apply in this filter. Only one group needs to be satisfied for the filter to pass. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition_groups))
- `conditions_no_longer_apply_behaviour` (String) Whether to remove announcement posts when the incident no longer matches this rule's conditions. Possible values are: `leave_in_place`, `remove`.
- `created_at` (String) When the rule was created
- `microsoft_teams_channel_ids` (Set of String) Microsoft Teams channels to post announcements into, as team_id/channel_id, when the organisation uses Microsoft Teams
- `mode` (String) Which incidents are announced: live incidents only, or triage incidents too. Possible values are: `live_and_closed`, `include_triage`, `include_triage_and_merged`, `include_declined_and_merged`, `include_all`.
- `owning_team_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the teams that own this rule
- `private_incident_scope` (String) Which private incidents this rule announces: every private incident (all), those an owning team can see (owning_teams), or none. Possible values are: `all`, `owning_teams`, `none`.
- `slack_channel_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the Slack channels to post announcements into, when the organisation uses Slack
- `template_id` (String) ID of the announcement template used to render this rule's posts
- `update_sharing_mode` (String) Where incident updates are shared once the incident is announced. Possible values are: `none`, `thread`, `thread_and_channel`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the rule was last updated
